objective: Validacion funcional final post R31, sin escrituras. Confirmar que LA ESTELAR tiene el dia operativo cerrado 2026-09-06 en la fuente canonica exacta que comparten Reportes ISCAM Ventas por Periodo y Dashboard Ejecutivo, revisar frescura hasta el ultimo dia cerrado disponible, y confirmar que una ejecucion reciente y exitosa de sync_comercial_v2 ya se registra con Exito=1 despues de la correccion del logger. No modificar codigo ni datos.

queries.name: estelar_20260906_fuente_canonica_compartida
queries.sql: SELECT unidad_negocio_id, unidad_negocio_nombre, CAST(fecha_operacion AS date) AS fecha_operacion, CAST(ISNULL(ventas_total,0) AS decimal(18,2)) AS ventas_total, CAST(ISNULL(propinas_total,0) AS decimal(18,2)) AS propinas_total, CAST(ISNULL(tickets_total,0) AS bigint) AS cheques_total, CAST(ISNULL(pax_total,0) AS bigint) AS pax_total FROM dbo.vw_Comercial_KPIs_Diarios_v2_Runtime WHERE unidad_negocio_id='ESTELAR' AND CAST(fecha_operacion AS date)=CONVERT(date,'2026-09-06')

queries.name: estelar_frescura_ultimos_dias
queries.sql: SELECT TOP 7 unidad_negocio_id, unidad_negocio_nombre, CAST(fecha_operacion AS date) AS fecha_operacion, CAST(ISNULL(ventas_total,0) AS decimal(18,2)) AS ventas_total, CAST(ISNULL(tickets_total,0) AS bigint) AS cheques_total, CAST(ISNULL(pax_total,0) AS bigint) AS pax_total FROM dbo.vw_Comercial_KPIs_Diarios_v2_Runtime WHERE unidad_negocio_id='ESTELAR' ORDER BY fecha_operacion DESC

queries.name: sync_comercial_v2_ultimo_finish
queries.sql: SELECT TOP 10 FechaAccion, RunID, Exito, MensajeError, JSON_VALUE(DetallesJSON,'$.status') AS status_detalle, TRY_CONVERT(int,JSON_VALUE(DetallesJSON,'$.processed_count')) AS processed_count, TRY_CONVERT(int,JSON_VALUE(DetallesJSON,'$.success_count')) AS success_count, TRY_CONVERT(int,JSON_VALUE(DetallesJSON,'$.failed_count')) AS failed_count, TRY_CONVERT(int,JSON_VALUE(DetallesJSON,'$.skipped_count')) AS skipped_count FROM dbo.Scheduler_BitacoraJobs WHERE JobName='sync_comercial_v2' AND Accion='FINISH' ORDER BY FechaAccion DESC

queries.name: sync_comercial_v2_actividad_3h
queries.sql: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT RunID) FROM dbo.Scheduler_BitacoraJobs WHERE JobName='sync_comercial_v2' AND Accion='START' AND FechaAccion>=DATEADD(HOUR,-3,SYSUTCDATETIME())) AS starts_3h, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT RunID) FROM dbo.Scheduler_BitacoraJobs WHERE JobName='sync_comercial_v2' AND Accion='FINISH' AND FechaAccion>=DATEADD(HOUR,-3,SYSUTCDATETIME()) AND Exito=1) AS finishes_exitosos_3h, (SELECT MAX(FechaAccion) FROM dbo.Scheduler_BitacoraJobs WHERE JobName='sync_comercial_v2' AND Accion='FINISH' AND Exito=1) AS ultimo_finish_exitoso, SYSUTCDATETIME() AS hora_consulta_utc
